classification.difficultyReason: Read the minimum and median, interpolate values between labelled ticks, and apply the standard endpoint and quartile differences for range and IQR.

content.prompt: The boxplot below gives information about the marks out of 100 obtained by a group of 40 people on a general knowledge quiz.

spec.description: Horizontal unfilled boxplot above its scale. Whiskers have no perpendicular endpoint caps. Ordinary source blue strokes are rendered in house black.
spec.answerVisibility: All source boxplot givens remain visible; no answer annotations are added.

children.label: a
children.prompt: What was the lowest mark obtained on the quiz?

answer.worked: The left whisker ends at 40, so the lowest mark was 40 out of 100.

children.label: b
children.prompt: What was the median mark obtained on the quiz?

answer.worked: The line inside the box is at 65, so the median mark was 65 out of 100.

children.label: c
children.prompt: What was the range of marks?

answer.worked:
The box extends from $Q_1=50$ to $Q_3=70$.

$$\begin{align*}\text{IQR}&=70-50\\\text{IQR}&=20\text{ marks}\end{align*}$$
